svg.title: Architecture: a 3-node kubeadm cluster on one host
svg.desc: An Ubuntu host with KVM runs multipass, which launches three VMs on the mpqemubr0 bridge. cp1 holds the control plane as static Pods (etcd, apiserver, controller-manager, scheduler); w1 and w2 run the workload Pods. Every node runs kubelet, containerd, calico-node and kube-proxy. Workers join the apiserver with kubeadm join, and the VMs are snapshotted so the cluster can be restored in about three minutes.
svg.text: Architecture: a 3-Node kubeadm Cluster on One Host
Three multipass VMs on a bare-metal Ubuntu host with KVM: one control-plane node and two workers, networked with Calico and snapshotted for break / fix practice.
bridge mpqemubr0 · NAT + dnsmasq DHCP · stable leases
PKI: leaf certs 1 y · CAs 10 y
Flannel has no NetworkPolicy — CKS needs it.
The CKA ran v1.35 when this was written:
No apt upgrade: the packages are on hold.
SVM on in the UEFI, /dev/kvm present,
cp1, w1, w2 on one bridge; swap off,
Pods. NotReady until the CNI runs.
Workers join with a fresh token
Aliases and ssh on cp1, then
Verified 2026-08-31 · Ubuntu 24.04.4 · multipass 1.16.3 · Kubernetes v1.34.11 · containerd 2.2.1 · Calico v3.32.2
